primary.title: NSE IPO: Explained | What is an 'observation letter' issued by Sebi as regulator okays ₹30,000 cr much-awaited issue
primary.summary: Sebi issued final observations for the NSE's IPO on September 4, allowing the exchange to proceed with its long-awaited public offering. The IPO will consist of a 149-million-equity-share offer, with market estimates valuing it at around ₹30,000 crore.

related.title: NSE IPO listing date, timeline: When ₹30,000 cr issue is expected to hit Indian stock market exchanges
related.summary: The NSE IPO, approved by Sebi, is set to raise around ₹30,000 crore, surpassing previous IPO records. Offering 149 million shares from existing shareholders, the IPO marks a significant milestone after years of delays due to regulatory issues and is expected to list in September 2024.
